reviews.reason: The model returns sufficient_evidence, outside the frozen status enum, and is rejected. It repeats the patient count but omits the period; its second claim is attached to E4 (Italian aims passage 17), although its wording comes from passage 54 (E3).

The invalid sufficient_evidence status is rejected. The raw statements give generic methodology/findings instead of the requested retrospective design and electronic records, and the limitations falsely deny study-design information present in Italian passages 19/68.

The invalid status is rejected. Raw claims invent a randomized gene-editing intervention, confuse the 2021 primary paper with the 2022 review, assign several claims to wrong passages, and reduce the parental-mosaicism range to an unsupported up-to-10-percent statement.
